note: Re-judged 2026-10-26 at HEAD dfabdcf8bf (independent judge, clean clone), after 3c8b9e42de and dd20e0aa1a changed installChildSA. Section 5.1: "If the SPD entry calls for PROTECT, i.e., creation of an SA, the key management mechanism (e.g., IKEv2) is invoked to create the SA." installChildSA now first calls child.innerGuard.retryStranded, which re-removes policies a failed removal left and releases their cross-peer records, then claims as before. That changes which negotiated SAs install, and adds no path from an outbound packet to IKEv2. A PROTECT entry is still installed only beside a Child SA IKEv2 already negotiated, and nothing under internal/component/ike or internal/plugins/ospf handles an XFRM acquire (the only XFRM_MSG_ACQUIRE and XFRMNLGRP_ACQUIRE hits are in vendor/github.com/vishvananda/netlink; the remaining 'acquire' hits are a migrate receiver comment, a lock comment and OSPF comments), and no trap or on-demand start action exists. parseSPDPolicy is unchanged. The {gap} text on the row stays accurate. Gap stands.
